checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: Checks show 48 samples to 48 distinct odd-column wells with 48 distinct tips (p1000 pick_up_tip/drop_tip per sample), and column-wise mapping to the same elution well index keeps traceability.
Code dispenses the 250 uL samples first (step 1), then isopropanol and beads afterwards, which reverses the required beads > isopropanol > sample order.
Two 500 uL ethanol washes each removed via remove_supernatant with the magnet engaged, then delay(minutes=4) and mag.disengage() before elution; checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min pass.
Code aspirates and dispenses ELUTION_VOL (100 uL) into the elution plate rather than about 80 uL as the paper specifies.
Sample is added before isopropanol and beads, a reordering relative to the paper, and the full 100 uL is recovered instead of 80 uL.

judge.summary: The protocol handles all 48 samples with fresh tips and uses correct washes, drying and temperature control. However, it adds the sample before isopropanol and beads, which reverses the required order. It also recovers 100 uL instead of about 80 uL, so binding, elution and fidelity score 0.
